requirements.title: Protocol type
requirements.text: The system shall define an MQTT protocol identifier (value 4) in the RELAY Protocol enum.

requirements.title: Spec version
requirements.text: The system shall expose SPEC_VERSION = "1.11" bound to the RELAY spec version so the two cannot drift.

requirements.title: Client trait
requirements.text: The system shall expose a Client trait with publish, subscribe, and close methods.

requirements.title: Subscription type
requirements.text: The system shall expose a Subscription type that delivers messages over an async channel.

requirements.title: Error sentinels
requirements.text: The system shall expose Closed, NotConnected, Timeout, PayloadTooLarge, TopicEmpty, and QoSUnsupported error variants.

requirements.title: Topic validation
requirements.text: publish and subscribe shall return TopicEmpty when an empty topic string is passed.

requirements.title: Lifecycle
requirements.text: close shall be idempotent; operations after close shall return Closed.

requirements.title: Concurrent safety
requirements.text: The Client trait implementation shall be safe for concurrent use from multiple async tasks.

requirements.title: Message topic
requirements.text: The system shall define a Message type with a non-empty topic field (UTF-8 string).

requirements.title: Message payload
requirements.text: The system shall define a Message type with a raw byte payload field.

requirements.title: Message QoS
requirements.text: The system shall define a Message type with a QoS field.

requirements.title: Message retained
requirements.text: The system shall define a Message type with a retained flag.

requirements.title: Message packet ID
requirements.text: The system shall define a Message type with a packet_id field (non-zero for QoS 1 and 2).

requirements.title: QoS AtMostOnce
requirements.text: The system shall define QoS::AtMostOnce (value 0) — fire-and-forget delivery.

requirements.title: QoS AtLeastOnce
requirements.text: The system shall define QoS::AtLeastOnce (value 1) — acknowledged delivery.

requirements.title: QoS ExactlyOnce
requirements.text: The system shall define QoS::ExactlyOnce (value 2) — exactly-once delivery.

requirements.title: QoS validation
requirements.text: QoS::try_from shall reject values outside 0-2.

requirements.title: Publish
requirements.text: Client::publish shall deliver the message to all matching subscribers.

requirements.title: Publish topic empty
requirements.text: Client::publish shall return TopicEmpty when topic is empty.

requirements.title: Publish retained
requirements.text: Client::publish_retained shall store the retained message and deliver it to future matching subscribers.

requirements.title: Publish retained clear
requirements.text: Client::publish_retained with empty payload shall clear the retained message.

requirements.title: Publish QoS 1 PUBACK
requirements.text: v3::Client::publish with QoS::AtLeastOnce shall wait for PUBACK before returning.

requirements.title: Publish QoS 1 timeout
requirements.text: v3::Client::publish with QoS::AtLeastOnce shall return Timeout if PUBACK is not received in 30s.

requirements.title: Subscribe
requirements.text: Client::subscribe shall deliver messages matching the topic filter to the subscription channel.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel
requirements.text: Subscription::recv shall return messages in delivery order.

requirements.title: Subscribe close
requirements.text: Subscription::close shall unsubscribe and drop the channel.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel depth
requirements.text: SubscriberConfig::channel_depth shall set the channel capacity; 0 uses the default (64).

requirements.title: Subscribe back-pressure
requirements.text: SubscriberConfig::back_pressure shall control DropNewest, DropOldest, or Block behaviour.

requirements.title: Subscribe wildcard hash
requirements.text: Client::subscribe shall accept '#' wildcard matching all non-system topics.

requirements.title: Subscribe wildcard plus
requirements.text: Client::subscribe shall accept '+' single-level wildcard.

requirements.title: Subscribe multi
requirements.text: Multiple concurrent subscriptions on the same client shall operate independently.

requirements.title: Wildcard exact match
requirements.text: match_topic shall return true when filter equals topic.

requirements.title: Wildcard hash all
requirements.text: match_topic '#' shall match all non-system topics.

requirements.title: Wildcard hash subtree
requirements.text: match_topic 'a/#' shall match 'a', 'a/b', and 'a/b/c'.

requirements.title: Wildcard plus single
requirements.text: match_topic '+' shall match any single-level topic.

requirements.title: Wildcard plus middle
requirements.text: match_topic 'a/+/c' shall match 'a/x/c' for any non-empty x.

requirements.title: Wildcard system no match
requirements.text: match_topic '#' shall NOT match topics beginning with '$'.

requirements.title: Wildcard plus no system
requirements.text: match_topic '+' at the first level shall NOT match '$' system topics.

requirements.title: Wildcard system exact
requirements.text: match_topic '$SYS/#' shall match '$SYS/...' topics.

requirements.title: v5 response topic
requirements.text: Message shall carry an optional response_topic field for MQTT v5 §3.3.2.3.5.

requirements.title: v5 correlation data
requirements.text: Message shall carry optional correlation_data bytes for MQTT v5 §3.3.2.3.6.

requirements.title: v5 user properties
requirements.text: Message shall carry a list of UserProperty key/value pairs for MQTT v5 §3.3.2.3.7.

requirements.title: v5 content type
requirements.text: Message shall carry an optional content_type string for MQTT v5 §3.3.2.3.9.

requirements.title: v5 expiry interval
requirements.text: Message shall carry an optional expiry_interval (seconds, 0 = no expiry) for MQTT v5 §3.3.2.3.3.

requirements.title: TCP connect
requirements.text: v3::Client::connect shall establish a TCP connection and complete the MQTT CONNECT/CONNACK handshake.

requirements.title: Connect client ID
requirements.text: ConnectOptions shall accept a client_id string.

requirements.title: Connect timeout
requirements.text: v3::Client::connect shall return Timeout if the handshake is not complete within connect_timeout.

requirements.title: Connect clean session
requirements.text: ConnectOptions shall accept a clean_session flag.

requirements.title: Connect username/password
requirements.text: ConnectOptions shall accept optional username and password credentials.

requirements.title: Connect keepalive
requirements.text: ConnectOptions shall accept a keepalive_secs value; the client shall send PINGREQ on schedule.

requirements.title: Connect LWT
requirements.text: ConnectOptions shall accept an optional WillMessage for last-will-and-testament.

requirements.title: Connect refused
requirements.text: v3::Client::connect shall return ConnectionRefused if the broker returns a non-zero CONNACK return code.

requirements.title: Disconnect
requirements.text: v3::Client::close shall send a DISCONNECT packet before closing the TCP connection.

requirements.title: Disconnect idempotent
requirements.text: v3::Client::close shall be idempotent — calling it twice shall not error.

requirements.title: Reconnect
requirements.text: After close, a new v3::Client::connect on the same address shall succeed.

requirements.title: Concurrent publish
requirements.text: Multiple async tasks shall be able to call Client::publish concurrently without data races.

requirements.title: Concurrent subscribe
requirements.text: Multiple async tasks shall be able to call Client::subscribe concurrently.

requirements.title: Concurrent recv
requirements.text: Multiple subscriptions on the same client shall receive independently without blocking each other.

requirements.title: Mock creation
requirements.text: MockClient::new shall create an in-process broker requiring no OS resources.

requirements.title: Mock pub/sub
requirements.text: MockClient shall implement full publish/subscribe with §4.7 wildcard semantics.

requirements.title: Mock closed errors
requirements.text: MockClient operations after close shall return Closed.

requirements.title: Mock retained
requirements.text: MockClient::publish_retained shall store and deliver retained messages to future subscribers.

requirements.title: Mock peer
requirements.text: MockClient::peer shall return a client sharing the same in-process broker.

requirements.title: Broker bind
requirements.text: Broker::start shall bind on the given address and accept connections.

requirements.title: Broker route
requirements.text: The broker shall route published messages to all matching subscribers.

requirements.title: Broker retained
requirements.text: The broker shall deliver retained messages to new subscribers.

requirements.title: RELAY spec version
requirements.text: The system shall expose SPEC_VERSION = "1.11" matching the RELAY spec.

requirements.title: RELAY protocol
requirements.text: The system shall use Protocol::Mqtt (value 4) in all relay::Message envelopes.

requirements.title: RELAY error sentinels
requirements.text: Error variants shall map to the four RELAY sentinels: Closed, NotConnected, Timeout, PayloadTooLarge.

requirements.title: RELAY back-pressure
requirements.text: BackPressurePolicy shall match RELAY spec §14: DropNewest=0, DropOldest=1, Block=2.

requirements.title: RELAY subscriber options
requirements.text: SubscriberOptions shall carry chan_depth and back_pressure.

requirements.title: RELAY Node trait
requirements.text: The system shall expose a Node trait implementing protocol(), send(), subscribe(), close().

requirements.title: RELAY adapt
requirements.text: adapt(client) shall wrap a Client as a relay::Node per §13.7 entry point.

requirements.title: RELAY to_message
requirements.text: Message::to_relay_message shall produce a relay::Message with meta keys mqtt.qos and mqtt.retained.

requirements.title: RELAY from_message
requirements.text: Message::from_relay_message shall restore topic, payload, QoS, and retained from meta.

requirements.title: RELAY CLI version
requirements.text: The CLI 'version' command shall output tool, protocol, protocol_int, version, spec_version, language.

requirements.title: RELAY CLI capabilities
requirements.text: The CLI 'capabilities' command shall output kind=capabilities, adapt=true, commands list.

requirements.title: RELAY CLI status
requirements.text: The CLI 'status' command shall output protocol, tool, version, healthy, connected, endpoint.

requirements.title: RELAY CLI convert
requirements.text: The CLI 'convert --protocol MQTT' shall read mqtt.Message JSON from stdin and write relay.Message JSON to stdout. Exit 0=ok, 1=invalid input, 2=invalid args.

requirements.title: RELAY Drainer
requirements.text: The system shall expose a Drainer trait for close_with_drain (§9).

requirements.title: RELAY HealthProvider
requirements.text: The system shall expose a HealthProvider trait returning HealthStatus.

requirements.title: RELAY MetricsProvider
requirements.text: The system shall expose a MetricsProvider trait returning MetricsSnapshot.

requirements.title: RELAY crossbar send sink
requirements.text: The CLI 'send --format json' shall read NDJSON relay.Message from stdin and publish each (crossbar destination mode, §11.2).

requirements.title: RELAY subscribe source
requirements.text: The CLI 'subscribe --format json' shall write received messages as NDJSON relay.Message to stdout (crossbar source mode, §11.2).

requirements.title: RELAY virtual module
requirements.text: The system shall expose a 'virtual' module alias for the in-process transport per §13.7.2.

requirements.title: RELAY golden vector
requirements.text: to_message and from_message shall produce output byte-identical to the RELAY spec/vectors/mqtt-message.json canonical vector.

requirements.title: No unsafe Rust
requirements.text: The library shall contain no `unsafe` blocks in library code (ASIL-B safe-Rust mandate, ISO 26262 Part 6 §8.4.2).

requirements.title: Defensive copy on subscribe
requirements.text: The subscribe path shall return a new Subscription instance and shall not share internal channel state across callers.

requirements.title: Back-pressure prevents unbounded memory
requirements.text: The system shall apply a configured back-pressure policy (DropNewest, DropOldest, or Block) when the subscriber channel is full, preventing unbounded memory growth.

requirements.title: Closed state is terminal
requirements.text: After close() returns Ok, all subsequent publish and subscribe calls shall return Err(Error::Closed). The closed state shall not be reversible.

requirements.title: Payload length bounds
requirements.text: The system shall reject publish payloads exceeding 268,435,455 bytes (MQTT §2.1 maximum) and return Err(Error::PayloadTooLarge).

requirements.title: Topic length bounds
requirements.text: The system shall reject empty topics (Err(Error::TopicEmpty)) and topics exceeding 65535 UTF-8 bytes (MQTT §4.7.3).

requirements.title: Atomic close under concurrency
requirements.text: The close operation shall be atomic: concurrent publish calls racing with close shall each either succeed or return Err(Error::Closed), never panic or deadlock.

requirements.title: SEOOC assumption documentation
requirements.text: The Safety Manual shall document Safety Element Out Of Context (SEOOC) assumptions and integration obligations per ISO 26262 Part 8 §6.

requirements.title: Tool qualification evidence
requirements.text: Tool qualification evidence for rustc (TQL-4), rsfusa (TQL-3), and relay (TQL-3) shall be present in the safety artifacts.

requirements.title: Requirement traceability 100%
requirements.text: Every requirement in requirements.json shall have at least one source annotation (//fusa:req) and at least one test reference. Coverage shall be 100% before release.

requirements.title: No code execution from network input
requirements.text: The library shall not execute any code derived from MQTT packet contents. All parsing shall produce typed values only (no eval, no unsafe transmute from network bytes).

requirements.title: Length-checked packet parsing
requirements.text: All variable-length fields in MQTT packets (topic, payload, protocol name) shall be bounds-checked against the declared length before accessing. Parsing shall return Err on malformed length.

requirements.title: Authentication credential handling
requirements.text: MQTT credentials (username, password) shall be transmitted only inside the CONNECT packet, never logged, and cleared from memory after use.

requirements.title: System topic namespace isolation
requirements.text: A bare `#` or `+` wildcard at the first level shall NOT match `$SYS/` topics (MQTT §4.7.2). System namespace must be explicitly addressed.

requirements.title: Dependency vulnerability scanning
requirements.text: The CI pipeline shall run `cargo audit` on every build and fail on known vulnerabilities rated CVSS >= 7.0.

requirements.title: SBOM present
requirements.text: A valid SPDX-2.3 SBOM shall be generated for every release listing all direct and transitive Rust dependencies.

requirements.title: Build provenance
requirements.text: Every release binary shall be accompanied by a SLSA-compatible provenance document recording builder, source, and build steps.

requirements.title: Packet-id uniqueness
requirements.text: Packet identifiers for QoS 1 PUBLISH and SUBSCRIBE shall be drawn from a monotonically increasing counter and never reused within a session.

requirements.title: HARA document present
requirements.text: A Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment document (hara.json) shall be present, covering all hazardous events, their severity, exposure, controllability, and ASIL determination.

requirements.title: Lost message hazard mitigated
requirements.text: The hazardous event 'vehicle signal update lost' (severity S2, exposure E4, controllability C2 → ASIL-B) shall be mitigated by QoS >= 1 on safety-critical signals.

requirements.title: Stale message hazard mitigated
requirements.text: The hazardous event 'stale retained message delivered' shall be mitigated by expiry_interval enforcement and documentation in the safety manual.

requirements.title: Topic misrouting hazard mitigated
requirements.text: The hazardous event 'message delivered to wrong subscriber' shall be mitigated by §4.7-compliant wildcard matching verified by 10+ unit tests.

requirements.title: Buffer exhaustion hazard mitigated
requirements.text: The hazardous event 'subscriber channel exhaustion causing system hang' shall be mitigated by configurable back-pressure policies (DropNewest, DropOldest, Block).

requirements.title: Error variants exhaustive
requirements.text: All fallible operations shall return Result<T, Error> where Error covers all possible failure modes. No operation shall panic on valid inputs.

requirements.title: IO errors wrapped
requirements.text: All std::io::Error values shall be wrapped in Error::Io, preserving the original cause for diagnostics.

requirements.title: Connection refused code preserved
requirements.text: CONNACK return codes (0x00–0x05) shall be preserved in Error::ConnectionRefused(code) for caller diagnostics.

requirements.title: Protocol error isolated
requirements.text: Malformed packet data received from the network shall produce Error::Protocol(description) and terminate the connection, not propagate raw bytes to the caller.

requirements.title: Timeout surfaces correctly
requirements.text: If a connect timeout expires before CONNACK is received, Error::Timeout shall be returned.

requirements.title: Error implements Send+Sync
requirements.text: Error shall implement Send + Sync so it can be used across async task boundaries and with anyhow/thiserror.

requirements.title: Health status queryable
requirements.text: Implementations shall optionally expose HealthProvider::health() returning HealthStatus { healthy, details }.

requirements.title: Metrics snapshot queryable
requirements.text: Implementations shall optionally expose MetricsProvider::metrics() returning MetricsSnapshot with publish/subscribe counters.

requirements.title: CLI status command
requirements.text: The CLI 'status' command shall report healthy=true when the binary is functional, per RELAY §12.

requirements.title: Subscription count observable
requirements.text: MockClient shall expose subscription_count() for test observability without requiring message exchange.

requirements.title: DO-178C Level D traceability
requirements.text: All requirements shall have bidirectional traceability: source annotation ↔ requirement record ↔ test. This satisfies DO-178C §5.1.1 (a) for DAL-D.

requirements.title: Structural coverage MC/DC eligible
requirements.text: All decision-bearing conditions in the library shall be exercisable by the test suite (MC/DC for DAL-A, DC for DAL-C; current suite satisfies DAL-D statement coverage).

requirements.title: Deactivated code absent
requirements.text: The library shall contain no permanently deactivated code (dead code), as prohibited by DO-178C §4.4.2 and detected by `cargo clippy --D dead_code`.

requirements.title: Configuration management baseline
requirements.text: All source, tests, requirements, and safety artifacts shall be under version control with an identified baseline (Cargo.lock committed, git tag per release).

requirements.title: Verification independence
requirements.text: The `relay-conform` CI job shall be independent of the `build-test` job, providing independent verification of RELAY conformance per DO-178C §6.4.

requirements.title: QoS 2 exactly-once handshake
requirements.text: The v3 TCP client's publish() shall complete the full PUBLISH→PUBREC→PUBREL→PUBCOMP handshake for QoS::ExactlyOnce (MQTT v3.1.1 §4.3.3) instead of returning immediately after PUBLISH.

requirements.title: TopicEmpty wraps NotConnected
requirements.text: Error::TopicEmpty shall wrap relay::Error::NotConnected via kind() per RELAY spec §5.4.

requirements.title: Context deadline
requirements.text: relay::Context shall carry an optional deadline (with_timeout()/done()) per RELAY spec §18.3, and NodeAdapter::send shall honor it, returning relay::Error::Timeout after the deadline expires.

requirements.title: Adapt() error kind preservation
requirements.text: NodeAdapter's send/subscribe/close shall map the underlying Client error to its real relay::Error kind via Error::kind() (RELAY spec §5.2) instead of a fixed sentinel.

requirements.title: DropOldest genuine eviction
requirements.text: BackPressurePolicy::DropOldest shall drain one message from the channel before enqueuing the arriving message (RELAY spec §10.5.3) in every implementation (mock, v3, the bundled relay module, and the Adapt() layer).

requirements.title: Canonical Health/Metrics shape
requirements.text: HealthStatus/MetricsSnapshot field names and per-field counting semantics shall mirror the RELAY spec §9/§9.1 canonical Health/Metrics shape so implementations of different protocols report comparable numbers.

requirements.title: CLI send/subscribe real broker connectivity
requirements.text: CLI send/subscribe shall connect to --broker over a real MQTT v3.1.1 TCP connection by default; --mock shall opt into the in-process mock broker instead.
